requirements.text: Students should have access to a library catalogue with filtering options, keyword searches, advanced search features, and real-time availability to enhance their search experience.
The system should allow students to borrow and renew items online, with access to loan history, automated notifications, and clear information about fines.
The booking system should provide real-time availability, flexible time slot selection, room capacity and features, cancellation/modification options, and automated confirmations and reminders.
Fines should be calculated automatically, with students having access to a transparent fine history, multiple online payment options, and automated notifications about their fine status.
The system should clearly communicate any restrictions related to fines or account issues when students attempt to borrow items or book study rooms.
The system must integrate smoothly with existing systems, such as the university’s student record system and single sign-on, to ensure security and ease of access.
The interface should be designed to be accessible for all users, including those with disabilities, ensuring an inclusive library experience.
